terms.shell: Keep as a technical noun when it names iNiR or the desktop-shell layer. Translate only when the target language has an established concise UI term.
terms.workspace: Use the normal desktop/compositor term in the target language, not a literal office-work translation.
terms.sidebar: Use the established UI term for a side panel or sidebar.
terms.keybind: Use the established term for a keyboard shortcut.
terms.provider: In AI settings this means a model/API provider, not an internet service provider.
terms.surface: In technical settings this means a shell UI surface or panel, not a physical material.
terms.pill: Keep the product UI term consistent. Do not translate it as medicine.
terms.island: Use the product visual term consistently. Do not replace it with unrelated navigation terminology.
